techStack: Runtime: Node.js, TypeScript 6.0.2, ESM (type: 'module'), bundler module resolution
Database: better-sqlite3 12.11.1 — raw SQL via db.prepare(), no ORM
Auth: bcryptjs 3.0.3 (hashing/compare); custom JWT util in src/utils/jwt.ts using JWT_SECRET env var
Validation: Zod 4.4.3 — schemas feed the validate() middleware which attaches parsed data to req.validated
TypeScript strict mode: noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters, verbatimModuleSyntax (ESM enforcement)
No ORM — all queries are raw prepared statements
features: Auth endpoints already exist: POST /api/auth/register, POST /api/auth/login, GET /api/auth/me
Users table: id (TEXT UUID PK), email (TEXT UNIQUE), username (TEXT UNIQUE), password (TEXT bcrypt hash), created_at (TEXT)
JWT utils (src/utils/jwt.ts): createJwt(data) signs HS256 with JWT_SECRET; verifyJwt(token) returns JwtPayload|null
requireAuth middleware (src/middleware/auth.ts): uses digit-sum checksum NOT real JWT; has rate limiting; must NOT be modified
validate middleware (src/middleware/validate.ts): accepts Zod schema, validates req body/params, attaches to req.validated, returns 400 on failure
authController.me (src/controllers/authController.ts): currently manually extracts Bearer token and calls getUserFromToken() — must be changed to use req.user.userId from requireJwt
authService (src/services/authService.ts): registerUser, loginUser, getUserFromToken, toUserResponse() strips password and camelCases timestamps
express.d.ts (src/types/express.d.ts): already extends Request with validated and id; needs user?: { userId: string } added
architecture: Layer order: routes → controllers → services → db (better-sqlite3 prepared statements)
Middleware pipeline: requestId → rateLimiter → cors → json → validate() → controller → errorHandler
app.ts mounts routes at path prefixes: /api/auth, /api/products, /api/favourites, /products; new /api/users must be added here
Schemas live in src/schemas/ — Zod objects exported and passed to validate()
Controllers: (req, res, next) functions; read from req.validated; delegate to services; pass errors to next(err) for errorHandler
Services: typed pure functions; use db.prepare() directly; throw AppError subclasses (AuthError, ValidationError, etc.) on failure; return typed response objects
Custom errors in src/errors/index.ts: AppError base with statusCode + code; subclasses include AuthError (401), ValidationError (400)
Types directory: src/types/express.d.ts for Express augmentation
New files go in: src/schemas/userSchema.ts, src/services/userService.ts, src/controllers/userController.ts, src/routes/userRoutes.ts
edgeCases: GET /api/auth/me with spoofed ?id=<other.id>&userId=<other.id> must return the token owner's data — controller must never read from query params
PATCH /api/users/me without Authorization header → 401 (requireJwt intercepts before controller runs)
PATCH with empty body {} → 400 (Zod schema must require at least one recognized field via .refine())
PATCH with body containing only unrecognized fields → 400 (same Zod .refine() rule)
PATCH with { newPassword } but no currentPassword → 400 (Zod must enforce newPassword requires currentPassword)
PATCH with correct currentPassword + newPassword: old password must fail login (401), new password must succeed (200)
PATCH with wrong currentPassword → 400 with exact message 'Current password is incorrect'
Stored password after update must match /^\$2[aby]?\$/ (bcrypt hash, not plaintext)
PATCH with { username: taken_by_other, email: taken_by_other } → 409 AND both username and email must remain original (no partial write)
PATCH with only email conflict → 409, all fields unchanged
Response from GET /api/auth/me and PATCH /api/users/me must never include a password field
updateUser must do a single atomic SQL UPDATE — no per-field sequential writes that could leave partial state on conflict
